packageRules.description: Open the PR as soon as a version is out, but keep its renovate/stability-days check pending for a week, so automerge waits: a hijacked or broken release is usually pulled within days
Gradle dependencies and the Gradle wrapper: one PR for every non-major update
Docker images of the Dockerfiles and the compose file: one PR for every non-major update
GitHub Actions: one PR for every non-major update
End-to-end test tooling: one PR for every non-major update
Merge minor and patch updates by themselves once every check is green; 0.x versions and majors stay manual
No PostgreSQL major upgrade: a new major cannot read the old data directory without a manual pg_upgrade
